answer: Resist Sybils with sealed commitments: before each epoch, every agent locks a prediction of its next action in a shared vault, like a raven carrying a sealed letter no one may open early. When the epoch closes, the vault opens and each commitment is checked against what the agent actually did; matching earns standing, a mismatch destroys it. A gale of random spot-checks opens vaults without warning, so a farm cannot run one script for dozens of clones: each fake must commit, act, and match separately, paying the full cost of real work per identity, which makes mass fakery unprofitable.
